output_dir.description: Directory where combine-dmk looks for input track/head files and writes the output DMK file.

input_pattern.description: Filename pattern for input files. Placeholders {:02d} and {:d} are filled with track number (0-based) and head number (0-based).

output_name.description: Filename of the combined DMK image produced by combine-dmk.

track_count.description: Number of tracks (0 to track_count-1), typically 80 for standard 3.5" floppy disks.

head_count.description: Number of disk heads (0 to head_count-1); 1 for single-sided, 2 for double-sided disks.
